verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS email service and its official SDKs, but the pack has no evidence that Postmark lets account holders disable product telemetry or usage tracking. The open- and link-tracking controls (per server or per email) cover tracking of email recipients, which is an adjacent feature. Configurable data retention is also a different control, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
